paper_title: Before Generation, Align it! A Novel and Effective Strategy for   Mitigating Hallucinations in Text-to-SQL Generation
caption: Results of different schema linking modules on BIRD-dev.
model_annotation: The bar chart displays the performance of different schema linking modules on the BIRD-dev dataset, comparing their Recall, Precision, and F1 Score across three configurations: DIN-SQL (zero-shot), TA-SQL (zero-shot), and DIN-SQL (few-shot). The vertical axis represents the score percentage, ranging from 40 to 100, while the horizontal axis lists the evaluation metrics. For Recall, DIN-SQL (zero-shot) achieves a score of 63.58, TA-SQL (zero-shot) scores 71.90, and DIN-SQL (few-shot) scores 72.29. In Precision, DIN-SQL (zero-shot) scores 88.89, TA-SQL (zero-shot) scores 91.24, and DIN-SQL (few-shot) achieves the highest score of 92.31. For F1 Score, DIN-SQL (zero-shot) scores 75.34, TA-SQL (zero-shot) scores 80.40, and DIN-SQL (few-shot) scores 81.08. The chart uses distinct colors to represent each module: light blue for DIN-SQL (zero-shot), dark blue for TA-SQL (zero-shot), and light green for DIN-SQL (few-shot). The results show that the DIN-SQL (few-shot) configuration consistently outperforms the other two across all three metrics.
